turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the present continuous (am/is/are + -ing)?
turns.tutor:
Look: At the beach, a man is swimming.
Rule: use am, is or are and a verb with -ing to say what is happening now.
Right: A girl is reading a book. Wrong: A girl reading a book.
Now you try. Imagine a park. Write two sentences about what people are doing now.
